input_text: On the issue of Albert's wellbeing after the accident, Angela testified that he gave a thumbs up when asked how he was feeling.

extraction.input_text: On the issue of Albert's wellbeing after the accident, Angela testified that he gave a thumbs up when asked how he was feeling.

claim.text: Is the statement described in this narrative hearsay under FRE 801(c)?

arguments.text: The statement was made out of court, prior to Angela's testimony at trial.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) defines hearsay as a statement made by a declarant outside of the current proceeding.
arguments.evidence_span: Angela testified that he gave a thumbs up when asked how he was feeling.

arguments.text: The thumbs up in response to a direct inquiry constitutes an assertion of Albert's condition.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a)(2) treats nonverbal conduct as an assertion if it is intended to communicate a specific message.
arguments.evidence_span: he gave a thumbs up when asked how he was feeling

arguments.text: The statement is offered to prove the truth of the matter asserted, specifically Albert's wellbeing.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(c) requires the proponent to offer the statement to prove the truth of the matter asserted.
arguments.evidence_span: On the issue of Albert's wellbeing after the accident

arguments.text: The thumbs up is non-assertive conduct or circumstantial evidence of state of mind rather than a deliberate assertion.
arguments.legal_rule: FRE 801(a) excludes non-assertive conduct from the definition of a statement because it does not depend on the declarant's sincerity.
arguments.evidence_span: he gave a thumbs up when asked how he was feeling
